Faction Research is unlocked upon completing the Short Term goal ⟦0⟧. It allows for Joint Research Facilities and Technology Sharing.

Faction members can make their Experimental Facilities into Joint Research Facilities at a cost of 1 ⟦0⟧ per facility. Only 3 Joint Research Facility may be assigned at a time, though they can be unassigned by its owner without any cost. Other faction members can assign Scientists to Joint Research Facilities to them as Supportive Scientists for 25 ⟦1⟧. A Supportive Scientist will work at 25% effectiveness at the facility, as well as earning 10% progress to a project in their own country for each iteration completed.

Faction members will gain a research bonus for technologies already unlocked by other member states. The research bonus starts at 0% and increases by 5% for every Supportive Scientist in the faction, multiplied by the number of member countries that have unlocked the technology, at a maximum of 50%. Note that the ⟦0⟧ already start with Technology Sharing via ⟦1⟧.

Faction Military Operations is unlocked upon completing the Short Term goal ⟦0⟧. It allows for Doctrine Sharing, Faction Theaters and Theater Commanders, as well as sharing manpower within the faction to use for garrisons.

Doctrine Sharing gives a Mastery bonus to any subdoctrine for which another faction member already has higher mastery. Each branch (land, navy and air) costs 1 ⟦0⟧ to unlock. The base value is 10 Mastery per month. Theater Commanders can increase the bonus by 2 Mastery per commander.

Faction Theaters are coordinated regions led by a Theater Commander. The number of regions and participating countries depends on the commanders Skill Level. Commanders gain Experience and their nations gain Doctrine Mastery from allied combat within their Theater. A faction can have a maximum of 4 Faction Theaters. Each costs 1 ⟦0⟧ to unlock and is owned by the country that unlocks it.

Each Faction Theater requires a Theater Commander. A country that owns a Faction Theater may assign any of its Field Marshals or Admirals as the Theater Commander. A Theater Commander and its Theater is assigned to a number of regions and countries, depending on the commander's skill level. The Theater Commander will only give bonuses to divisions controlled by the countries selected, within the regions it has been assigned. The Theater Commander's country receives a portion of the Mastery earned by other faction members in the theater based on the commander's Attack and Defense skills. Selected countries in a theater receive a bonus to land and naval Supply Consumption, based on the commander's Planning and Logistics, or Maneuvering and Coordination skills. An Admiral will convey a higher bonus to naval supply consumption, whereas a Field Marshal will convey a better bonus to land supply consumption.

Faction members can choose to contribute 0, 5, 10 or 15% of their monthly manpower gain to a shared garrison manpower pool. Manpower can be requested when a country has occupied enemy territory based on its contribution level. A country may only request manpower that was contributed by other countries.
